name: ems-frontend
_versionNotes: Pinned to the widely-adopted React 18 / React Router v6 lineage for maximum library compatibility as of Sep 2026. React 19.2.x and React Router v8 are also current and available, but v8 is ESM-only, requires Node 22+/React 19.2.7+, and renames the 'react-router-dom' package to 'react-router' with breaking API changes — upgrade deliberately, not as a drop-in.
